maria: quick heads-up: noticed a p95 bump (~120ms -> ~220ms) on /generate for 13B yesterday after the batching heuristics change. saw kernel switching mid-request :thinking_face:
lee: do you have a sample request id or trace id? helps narrow whether it's routing or kernel selection thrash
maria: trace id 6f2a9b3c, saw it in the per-request breakdown view. attaching the small profiler snippet I grabbed from the trace view:
```
kernel_select: 95ms
kv_lookup: 8ms
attention_forward: 60ms
attention_kv_swap: 40ms
token_emit: 9ms
```
oliver: that kernel_select number is huge. our usual is ~10-15ms, so something re-evaluated choice during decoding (maybe batch size dropped and we recompiled a path?) :eyes:
devin: FYI I rolled the batching heuristic tweak (prefer smaller batches under tail latency pressure) last night at 03:10 UTC. it will force early flush for mixed-size requests. could cause more kernel flapping for long-context streams
perf-bot: profile-summary for trace 6f2a9b3c: total=218ms, kernel_select=95ms, attention=100ms, kv_io=48ms (includes 2 swaps). link: https://perf.internal/reports/6f2a9b3c :thumbsup:
maria: here's the per-route KPI snapshot I pulled from the dashboard (route=/generate): p50=65ms, p90=140ms, p95=220ms, p99=420ms. spike aligns with the deployment window
lee: can we correlate kernel_select spikes to KV hit-rate? if cache miss & swap happens we might trigger different kernel path (quant swapping)
oliver: agreed — I saw a pattern where mixed-batch with single long prompt + many short prompts causes KV cache eviction thrash. eviction leads to swap+recompile on the next token which inflates kernel_select
devin: question: do we have instrumentation to tag metric series with batch_shape and kv_hit boolean for the per-request breakdown view? would make dashboard slicing easy
maria: current token-level latency breakdown has fields: kernel_ms, attention_ms, kv_ms, emit_ms, but not batch_shape or kv_hit. I prototyped adding `kv_hit:true/false` in the trace payload yesterday
sre_oncall: if we add `trace_id -> perf.trace` link in the route dashboard per-request rows that'd help incident drills. right now you have to paste ids manually :grimacing:
lee: small proposal: emit these extra attrs in the token timeline event: batch_size, batch_element_index, kv_hit, kernel_variant. then expose in per-route table and make kernel_variant a column to filter by
perf-bot: quick query suggestion: `sum by (kernel_variant) (rate(kernel_select_ms_bucket[5m]))` and `kv_hit_rate = kv_hits / kv_lookups` — can join by request_id in the logs to get per-request alignment
oliver: on the runtime side I can add a light-weight tag for kernel_variant (string) to the trace span; should be cheap. also throttle recompile path so we don't recompile more than once per request unless model/shape changes
maria: another datapoint: I replayed the exact trace under `--replay-mode=verbose` and saw a `choose_kernel()` path hit twice because batch size changed after prefix tokens were emitted. adding that to the trace log:
```
[choose_kernel] batch_shape=(4,512) -> kernel=kv-optimized-8bit
[choose_kernel] batch_shape=(1,512) -> kernel=attn-lowlat-16bit
```
devin: that confirms it. batching heuristic change is causing batch-shape churn mid-request for streams that start with group prompts then fall to singletons. we can tweak to avoid re-eval until a token boundary window or only re-eval after N tokens
lee: short-term mitigation: add a dashboard alert rule for kernel_select > 40ms for p95 on any model. also add a per-route column with `kernel_variant` and `kv_hit` so SREs can immediately see the pattern
sre_oncall: oncall will take the alert, but we need triage playbook step: link trace -> request-inspector -> live logs -> kernel variant. if we can get a one-click flow that's huge
maria: I can PR the trace schema change to include batch_shape and kernel_variant today. WIP patch includes example payload. devin, want me to make the per-route Inspector show trace link too?
devin: please do. I'll add a small debounce in heuristics: don't re-run kernel selection for the same request until 3 tokens pass or batch shape changes by >50%
oliver: also will implement a lightweight kv_hit flag earlier in the KV lookup path so traces mark misses before swap starts
lee: nice. follow-ups: 1) PR for trace schema by EOD, 2) dashboard column + alert, 3) heuristic debounce change behind flag for canary. assign owners and timelines in the ticket
maria: created ticket RDW-3421 with owners: maria (trace schema), devin (heuristic debounce), oliver (kv flag), lee (dash alerts). ETA 48h for initial canary :rocket:
perf-bot: noted: RDW-3421 created, links: https://issues.internal/RDW-3421
maria: thanks all. ping me if you need sample traces or replay harness configs. :heart:
lee: great progress. will loop in product if this affects SLAs
